headline: Payback period for investment shortens, rental yield comes to the fore again: Home pays for itself in 13 years
summary: Rents are rising faster than home sale prices, shortening the average payback period across Türkiye to about 13 years. Rental yields in metropolitan areas have picked up again.
why: Rental yield and payback period are key metrics for property investors comparing housing with other assets in Turkey.
